proof_summary: Since a nonunit product cannot come from an empty associated-prime set, choose its maximum element \(m\). If a prime \(q\le\sqrt{2n-m}\) divided \(2n-m\), then \(q\le\sqrt{2n}\) and \(m\equiv2n\pmod q\), contradicting the defining residue-avoidance condition; hence \(2n-m\) is prime, and together with the primality of \(m\) this gives the required partition.
